subject: Television & Streaming
title: The Lone Ranger's Moral Code
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on The Lone Ranger's Moral Code.

hook.text: The Lone Ranger never shot to kill. He used silver bullets to remind himself that life has value.

buildup.text: Each episode followed a strict code: help the helpless, fight for justice, never reveal your identity.

discovery.text: The show taught a generation of children about honor. Parents trusted the Lone Ranger as a moral teacher.

twist.text: Actor Clayton Moore became so identified with the role that courts later barred him from wearing the mask.

climax.text: A children's western became one of TV's first examples of a character bigger than the actor who played him.

punchline.text: A masked cowboy taught millions of kids right from wrong.

quiz.question: Why did the Lone Ranger use silver bullets?
options: As a reminder that life has value
